title: the repository's tools are one Bun program over JSON records under `data/`, and a file rendered from the records is committed, marked and never edited
scope:
the repository's own tooling: what runs it, where a fact a tool reads is kept, how a record is
written, and what a file rendered from the records is. It does not decide the perf currency, which
[0220](0220.md) owns, and it changes nothing a Novis program or the `nvs` binary does.
validatedBy:
`bun nv audit python`, `bun nv check`, `bun nv render --check` and `bun nv rules --render --check`,
the last three in CI's `docs` job; `tools/nv/test/records.test.ts` for the writer's one text per value.
